mainEntity.name: How does Prompt's pricing work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prompt uses transparent, flat-rate per-provider pricing. There are no hidden fees for essentials like reminders, digital intake, home exercise program (HEP) delivery, or reporting. What you see is what you pay.

mainEntity.name: How does Prompt's pricing compare to other EMRs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many platforms advertise a low base price, then charge extra for the tools clinics use every day. With Prompt, appointment reminders, digital intake, claim scrubbing, and billing tools are included in your plan. Reminders help reduce no-shows, AI intake speeds up eval documentation, and claim scrubbing catches errors before submission. Compare the total cost, not just the base price, and many practices find Prompt comes out ahead.

acceptedAnswer.text: Completely. Clinics can build unlimited custom templates for notes, evals, goals, tables, and scheduling, with no support ticket required. Automations and dashboards are configurable too.

acceptedAnswer.text: Prompt's AI is purpose-built for rehab therapy workflows, not adapted from general medicine tools.
